item.title: Echo
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FAIRYTALE HARDCOVER
  • 発売日: 2000-02-25
  • スコア: 6.09/10 (7 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Echo
  • 英語名: 无

あらすじ

This story starts within darkness Introduction

Suddenly my eyes opened.

I got the feeling I had been having some kind of terrible dream.

Is it night…?

Or is it that my eyes were still blurry…?

I slowly returned to consciousness.

The space around me was pitch black.

I sat up, and felt a sharp pain in my arm.

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FAIRYTALE HARDCOVER
  • 発売日: 1995-05-26
  • スコア: 7.15/10 (13 人評価)
  • 日本語名: マリアに捧げるバラード
  • 英語名: Maria ni Sasageru Ballade

别名

  • Ballade for Maria

あらすじ

In “Ballade For Maria”, you control Jake Snipes, a detective from New York. Recently, terrible murders have been happening at a number of cities in the United States. An unknown killer seeks out women, brutally murders and mutilates them. As Jake investigates a missing person case for an actress he met at a party, the string of murders reaches his very city.

item.title: Necronomicon
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: FAIRYTALE HARDCOVER
  • 発売日: 1994-06-24
  • スコア: 6.959999999999999/10 (22 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ネクロノミコン
  • 英語名: Necronomicon

あらすじ

Necronomicon is - as the title strongly implies - based on the writings of H.P. Lovecraft. The story is set in Lovecraft’s fictional city Arkham somewhere in New England. It is said that a terrible ritual has taken place there, involving a woman giving birth to a demonic child. A journalist named Jonathan heads to Arkham to find out more about the dreadful rumors, and to explore the ruins of an ancient monastery. In the town, Jonathan meets other characters with their own agendas. Terrifying nightmares, like visions from the past, haunt Jonathan. Will he be able to preserve his sanity and solve the mystery?
